title: Remade a game from 2000 that i played way too much as a kid
author: cuxes
selftext:
As a kid i played Battle Painters a lot (2000, Saito Games, the follow up to Painters from 1995 by JJSoft). 4 players run around all the time, you can only steer left and right and your trail paints the floor. Whoever painted the most wins the round.

I threw the old exe into claude with access to [https://github.com/morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea) and go through the decompiled code. Didn't expect much but it came back with a full spec: tick rate, how turning works, item timings, even how the cpu players decide where to go.  
Then claude code rebuilt it in typescript with just canvas, no engine. The game logic is deterministic, which made online play pretty easy - the server only sends inputs and every browser simulates the same match. You can share a room link or just join a public room.

Nothing from the original is in there (art, sound, music), only used it as reference.

Would love to hear how the play in general feels for you, what do you think of the style and the music and if you have any suggestions to make it more fun :)

Give it a try: [https://canvasclash.online](https://canvasclash.online)
